definition.name: Motor Claim
definition.description: A customer's motor claim, from the day it is reported to the follow-up after payment.

stages.name: Reported
stages.description: The claim is registered and its documents collected.

stages.name: Assessed and settled
stages.description: The damage is assessed, the claim is routed, and the customer is paid.

stages.name: Followed up
stages.description: The customer is asked how it went.

workflows.name: Claim Intake
workflows.description: Registers a new claim, asks the customer for the documents that are missing, and waits for them.

activities.name: Register claim
activities.description: Create the claim record.

activities.name: Request documents
activities.description: Write to the customer listing the documents needed.

activities.name: Send reminder
activities.description: Remind the customer that the documents are still missing.

activities.name: Check completeness
activities.description: Confirm every required document is present.

activities.name: Close as incomplete
activities.description: Close the claim because the documents never arrived.

events.name: Claim submitted
events.description: The customer submits a claim in the portal.

events.name: Documents uploaded
events.description: Wait for the customer to upload the documents.

events.name: Reminder answered
events.description: Wait once more after the reminder.

events.name: Claim registered
events.description: Tell other systems the claim is complete.

workflows.name: Motor Claim Settlement
workflows.description: Settles a motor insurance claim: registers it, has an AI agent assess the damage under an outcome contract, checks fraud signals and policy cover in parallel, routes by risk, and pays the claimant. Funds reserved for a payment that later fails are released.

roles.name: Claims system
roles.description: The system of record for claims

roles.name: Damage assessor
roles.description: Estimates repair costs from descriptions and photos

roles.name: Claims adjuster
roles.description: Decides claims above the automatic limit

activities.name: Register claim
activities.description: Create the claim record and attach the policy number.

activities.name: Assess damage
activities.description: Estimate the repair cost and severity from the claim description and photos.
activities.procedure: Read the claim description. Identify each damaged part. Price parts and labour from the repair catalogue. State the severity.

criteria.name: Parts itemised
criteria.description: The assessment lists the damaged parts.

tools.name: price_part
tools.description: Price of a replacement part, with fitting, from the repair catalogue.

activities.name: Check fraud signals
activities.description: Score the claim for fraud indicators.

activities.name: Verify policy cover
activities.description: Confirm the policy was in force and covers this kind of damage.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: The policy's status, cover and excess.

activities.name: Consolidate findings
activities.description: Combine the assessment, the fraud score and the cover check into one case file.

activities.name: Adjuster review
activities.description: A claims adjuster reviews claims that are too large to settle automatically.

activities.name: Investigate
activities.description: A fraud investigator takes over claims with strong fraud signals.

activities.name: Reserve funds
activities.description: Reserve the settlement amount.

activities.name: Pay claimant
activities.description: Transfer the settlement to the claimant's account.

tools.name: transfer
tools.description: Transfer money to the claimant's account.

activities.name: Notify claimant
activities.description: Write to the claimant confirming the settlement.

activities.name: Release funds
activities.description: Release funds that were reserved for a payment that did not go through.

events.name: Bank cut-off
events.description: Payments are released after the bank's cut-off.

decision_nodes.name: Settlement route
decision_nodes.description: Choose how the claim is settled. Clear cases are decided by the table; the rest by a model, within three options.

decision_model.instructions: Decide how to settle a motor claim that the rules did not settle. Prefer review when the cost is high or the fraud score is middling. Choose investigate only for concrete fraud indicators.

options.description: Routine claim that can be paid without a person looking at it
A claims adjuster should look at it before payment
There are concrete signs of fraud

workflows.name: Customer Follow-up
workflows.description: After a claim is paid, asks the customer how it went and acts on the answer.

activities.name: Send survey
activities.description: Ask the customer to rate the claim experience from 1 to 5.

activities.name: Thank customer
activities.description: Thank a satisfied customer.

activities.name: Call back
activities.description: A customer care agent calls a dissatisfied customer.

activities.name: Record no response
activities.description: Note that the customer did not answer.
